_source_note: New class built (Sept 2026) from 53 real Ascension screenshots (Runemaster.docx, exact levels/numbers/costs) plus the big CoA handoff doc for structure, spec identity, and passive filler (per Kyle's established two-source pattern: screenshots are authoritative for numbers, handoff doc fills in talent-tree shape and flavor). 3 specs confirmed, no healer/tank: Glyphic (ranged Intellect caster, Arcane Mage analog - glyph-stacking builder/spender), Engravement (Agility melee, Enhancement Shaman analog - weapon-proc weaving), Riftblade (Agility melee, Enhancement/Frost DK hybrid - elemental strike weaving). Mana + Runes dual-resource (Runes = the Frost/Fire/Arcane Glyph-cycle system, already stubbed in combat/abilities.py's ResourceType.RUNES before this session). Cloth armor per the handoff doc's own class header, but base stats hybridized (some Agility) since 2 of 3 specs are melee - see Character.py's Runemaster stat block.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: A basic staff strike.

abilities.name: Runeblade
abilities.description: Slice an enemy with a rune-etched blade.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 3 Mana, melee range, instant, 'Requires Melee Weapon', 3 Charges/6 sec recharge, '24 Elemental Damage.' Core level-1 melee filler - charge system compressed to a short flat cooldown for this engine, extended to 8 ranks per Kyle's starting-ability rank-up direction.

abilities.name: Primordial Blast
abilities.description: Launch a primordial missile at an enemy. Real dynamic school: deals whichever element (Frost/Fire/Arcane) you're currently Attuned to, matching Runemaster's actual identity as a rune-cycling caster - not a fixed school.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, '27 Elemental Damage.' Core ranged spell option, extended to 8 ranks.

abilities.name: Weapon Engraving: Fire
abilities.description: Engrave a fire rune onto your weapon, granting Fire Engraving: your direct damage has a chance to stack Firebrand on the target, which explodes into Fire damage on expiry. Only one Engraving active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 1, 2 Mana, 'Your direct damage has a 30% chance to apply Firebrand to the target, stacking up to 100 times... When this effect expires, it explodes, dealing 17 Fire damage per stack.' 1hr real duration modeled as 30-min WoW-buff-style per project convention. Stack-and-detonate proc mechanic not fully modeled - see _implementation_note.
abilities._implementation_note: The stacking-Firebrand-detonate mechanic isn't modeled yet (engine has no per-stack DoT-on-expiry primitive) - implemented as a flat self-buff placeholder. All 5 Weapon Engravings share this gap; revisit as a group once a stacking-proc mechanism exists.

abilities.name: Weapon Engraving: Ice
abilities.description: Engrave an ice rune onto your weapon, granting Ice Engraving: your direct damage has a chance to deal Frost damage and slow the target, stacking Icebound Momentum for bonus damage. Only one Engraving active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6, 2 Mana, 'Your direct damage has a 40% chance to deal 14 Frost damage and reduce the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec... The Runemaster deals 1% additional damage per stack as Frost damage. Stacks up to 8 times and lasts 12 sec.'

abilities.name: Runic Tattoos: Earth
abilities.description: Attune yourself with the earth, increasing Armor and Nature Resistance. Only one Tattoo active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, '+75 Armor, +5 Nature resistance.'

abilities.name: Runic Tattoos: Frost
abilities.description: Attune yourself to frost, increasing Frost Resistance and slowing attackers who strike you. Only one Tattoo active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10, '+5 Frost resistance, melee/ranged attacks against you slow the attacker's movement speed and attack speed by 20% for 8 sec.'

abilities.name: Runic Tattoos: Water
abilities.description: Attune yourself with water, restoring mana over time and reducing spell costs. Only one Tattoo active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, 'restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds and reducing the mana cost of your spells and abilities by 5%.'

abilities.name: Weapon Engraving: Earth
abilities.description: Engrave an earth rune onto your weapon, granting Earth Engraving: your direct damage has a chance to deal Nature damage to nearby enemies. Only one Engraving active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14, 2 Mana, 'Your direct damage has a 15% chance to deal 1 Nature damage to enemies within 8 yds of your target.'

abilities.name: Etching of the Leylines
abilities.description: Enhance an ally, increasing their total stats.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, '+10% total stats.'

abilities.name: Elemental Burst
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with elemental force. Real dynamic school: deals whichever element (Frost/Fire/Arcane) you're currently Attuned to, matching Runemaster's actual identity as a rune-cycling caster - not a fixed school.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6, '31 Elemental Damage.' Glyphic's real generator per the handoff doc ('Elemental Burst - Elemental damage + generates a Glyph').

abilities.name: Runic Tattoos: Air
abilities.description: Attune yourself to the air, increasing movement speed and resistance to slows. Only one Tattoo active.
abilities._source: Per CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts movement speed; boosts movement-slow resistance.' Exact numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot in this batch.

abilities.name: Palm Sigil: Fire
abilities.description: Engrave a fire rune into your palm: your next direct damaging spell deals bonus damage as Fire. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, 'your next direct damaging spell deals 70% bonus damage as Fire. Lasts 6 sec.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Palm Sigil family (Fire/Earth/Arcane/Water/Frost).

abilities.name: Inscription: Leyline
abilities.description: Attune an ally to the leylines, increasing damage and healing taken from spells.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, 'increasing damage taken from spells by up to 15 and healing spells by up to 16. Lasts 30 min.' A support debuff-on-ally (amplifies incoming spell effects) - real Focus Magic-style tool.

abilities.name: Palm Sigil: Earth
abilities.description: Engrave an earth rune into your palm: your next Magic damage stuns the target. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 8, 'your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec stuns a target enemy for 4 sec.' Part of the Palm Sigil family.

abilities.name: Etching of the Dextrous
abilities.description: Enhance an ally, increasing their Agility.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, '+10 Agility. Lasts 30 min.'

abilities.name: Ley Lock
abilities.description: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting, school-locking them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, 'preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 2.50 sec.' Real hard interrupt shared across all 3 specs per the handoff doc.

abilities.name: Ice Rune
abilities.description: Unleash a frost rune at an enemy, stunning them. Requires a Frozen target.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, 'Requires Frozen Target. Unleash a frost rune at an enemy, stunning them for 4 sec. Affected enemies are considered Frozen.' Real combo-mechanic ability - requires the target already have the Frozen tag from another spell (e.g. Frigid Blast, Hoarfrost). Frozen-tag prerequisite not yet enforced mechanically.

abilities.name: Palm Sigil: Arcane
abilities.description: Engrave an arcane rune into your palm: your next Magic damage also deals Arcane damage over time and silences. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 'an additional 5% of the damage dealt as Arcane damage every 3 sec for 12 sec and silences the target for 3 sec.' Part of the Palm Sigil family.

abilities.name: Leyfeed
abilities.description: Feed off the latent magic of an enemy, stealing beneficial magic effects from them. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, 'stealing 2 beneficial magic effects from them.'

abilities.name: Weapon Engraving: Air
abilities.description: Engrave an air rune onto your weapon, granting Air Engraving: increases attack/cast speed, and your direct damage has a chance to replicate a % of the damage, ignoring Armor. Only one Engraving active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 2 Mana, '+10% melee, ranged, and spell casting speed. Your direct damage has a 15% chance to replicate 30% of the damage dealt. Replicated damage ignores armor.'

abilities.name: Weapon Engraving: Water
abilities.description: Engrave a water rune onto your weapon, granting Water Engraving: your direct damage has a chance to drain mana and deal Frost damage, also granting nearby allies Replenishment. Only one Engraving active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 26, 2 Mana, 'Your direct damage has a 30% chance to drain up to 2% of your maximum mana from the target, restoring the amount drained and dealing Frost damage based on how much mana was drained. Also grants nearby allies Replenishment: Replenishes 5% of maximum mana per 5 sec for 15 sec.'

abilities.name: Palm Sigil: Water
abilities.description: Engrave a water rune into your palm: your next Magic damage drains the target's mana. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 32, 'drains the target's mana equal to 50% of the damage dealt.' Part of the Palm Sigil family.

abilities.name: Palm Sigil: Frost
abilities.description: Engrave a frost rune into your palm: your next Magic damage deals extra Frost damage and slows the target. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 34, '30% of the damage dealt as Frost damage and slow the enemy's movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.' Part of the Palm Sigil family.

abilities.name: Leyline Adjustment
abilities.description: Adjust the leylines beneath you, redirecting the threat you generate to a targeted party member.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 60, 'redirecting the threat you generate for 30 sec to the targeted party member.' Real tank-support redirect tool, capstone-tier class-wide utility.

abilities.name: Frigid Blast
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with frigid runic magic, applying Frigid Fusion.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 6 Mana, 35yd, 2s cast, 15s CD, '73 Frost damage and applying Frigid Fusion: accumulate 20% of your damage dealt to the target over 6 sec, then deal it as Frost damage.' Accumulate-and-release mechanic not yet dynamically modeled.

abilities.name: Primordial Pulse
abilities.description: Inscribe an area with runes, repeatedly damaging enemies inside. Real dynamic school: deals whichever element (Frost/Fire/Arcane) you're currently Attuned to at cast time, locked in for the zone's whole duration - matching Runemaster's real rune-cycling identity.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Glyphic-locked, Lvl 34, '34 Elemental Damage every 0.50 sec to up to 5 enemies inside.'

abilities.name: Glyphic Ruin
abilities.description: Unleash your active Glyph's effect on an enemy for Elemental damage. Real dynamic school: deals whichever element (Frost/Fire/Arcane) you're currently Attuned to, matching Runemaster's actual identity as a rune-cycling caster - not a fixed school.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Glyphic-locked, Lvl 20, '153 Elemental Damage.' The spec's real spender - consumes Glyph stacks per the handoff doc.

abilities.name: Thaumaturgy
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with Arcane damage and unleash your active Glyph effect.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Glyphic-locked, Lvl 36, '99 Arcane damage and unleash your active Glyph effect.' Cheap instant Glyph-dump per the handoff doc.

abilities.name: Eye of the Beholder
abilities.description: Increases spell critical strike chance and empowers Glyphic Ruin and Primordial Blast damage.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Boosts spell crit chance; boosts Glyphic Ruin/Primordial Blast damage while active.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Manuscription
abilities.description: A strong Arcane DoT that envelops the target and nearby enemies.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Arcane DoT enveloping target + nearby; grants Transcribing.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Glyphic Overload
abilities.description: Instantly grants all 3 Glyphs and empowers their next unleash effect. Usable while stealthed.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as the Glyphic capstone. Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot; grants 3 Runes stacks as an approximation of 'instantly grants all 3 Glyphs.'

abilities.name: Devour Mana
abilities.description: Destroy an enemy's mana, dealing Arcane damage based on the amount burned.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Destroys enemy mana; each point burned deals Arcane damage.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Fist of the Ancients
abilities.description: Smash your target and a nearby enemy with your rune-engraved fists, triggering Weapon Engraving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Engravement-locked, Lvl 24, '74 Elemental Damage and triggering your Weapon Engraving.'

abilities.name: Runic Brand
abilities.description: Brand an enemy with both weapons, marking them. Your next Runeblade on the marked enemy triggers a Runic Explosion.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Engravement-locked, Lvl 18, 4 Mana, melee range, instant, 12s CD, '23 Fire damage with each weapon, and marking the enemy for 8 sec... Your next Runeblade on the enemy causes a Runic Explosion, dealing an additional 167 Spellfire Damage to nearby enemies.' Mark-and-detonate mechanic not fully modeled - implemented as a straightforward DoT for now.

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Resets Fist of the Ancients cooldown; enables Runeshroud-required abilities + castable while moving.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Engravement's burst capstone: 'Boosts Weapon Engraving trigger chance, for a duration.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Marks your location; at expiry/reactivation, warps back + heals you.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Genesis

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Runic Brand banks a % of your damage, unleashes after a delay as Elemental damage; triggers Weapon Engraving on hit.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Turbulence

abilities.name: Silencing Rune

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground area, activates after a delay: silences enemies inside.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Runes of Quickness

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid spell haste buff (no stacking with similar); boosts Glyphic spell range.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground rune: dispels harmful magic from allies, purges beneficial magic from enemies in radius.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.
